desc:
Welcome to Grow a Snowman ❄️

☃️Roll snowballs and build your snowman
📏Grow it as BIG as you can!
🚜Collect snow faster with pushers and vehicles
🧱Press snow into bricks and freeze them into icy bricks
🐧Unlock new snowmen: Penguin, Golem, Yeti, Dragon, Phoenix and more
✨Use toxic and icy snow to get rare auras
🎩Dress up your snowman with accessories
💰Collect your snowman and sell it for coins
🏠Upgrade your base to unlock new machines
📈Climb the leaderboard with the tallest snowman!
